blocks.text: INT-02 you have learned the names of institutions; in B1-16 The first vocabulary of the political chronicle. Now you enter political life as the newspapers tell: elections (campagna, turnout, strip, seats, ballots), governments (task, formation, coalition, reshuffle, distrust, resignation), parties and currents, referendums and constitutional reforms, the language of political crises and the passage of powers. You also learn to recognize regional variants of office names and procedures, and report results and percentages without errors. All the countries, parties and politicians of the texts are invented. Four weeks, in parallel with EGY-12.

Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. understand and report a complete electoral news: turnout, results, seats, ballots, disputes;
2. follow the stages of a government crisis and the formation of a government (office, consultations, confidence,
3. distinguishing the names of the offices and procedures in the different Arab countries and translating them with Italian equivalents
4. recognizing the lexicon of political positions (majority, opposition, coalition, currents) without
5. read a political service of 350 words at least 80 words per minute and summarize it in a neutral manner.
